MagicCocktail.NAME: Magic Cocktail
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, add a #yBed #yOf #yMagic to your hand.

HiddenMagicCocktail.NAME: Hidden Magic Cocktail
DESCRIPTIONS: Replaces #yMagic #yCocktail. At the start of each combat, add a #yBed #yOf #yMagic+ to your hand.

BedOfChaos.NAME: Bed Of Chaos
BedOfChaos.FLAVOR: A seedbed born from magic mixed beyond control.
DESCRIPTIONS: Replaces #yMagic #yCocktail. At the start of each turn, gain a #yBed #yOf #yMagic effect for a random number of Attack and Skill cards.

BequestOfSeath.NAME: Bequest Of Seath
BequestOfSeath.FLAVOR: A cold, pale inheritance from a blind seeker of immortality.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you play a Magic card each turn, gain [E] .

ScrollOfLogan.NAME: Scroll Of Logan
ScrollOfLogan.FLAVOR: A scroll left by Big Hat Logan's tireless study.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, add a random Crystal card to your hand.

OolacileIvoryCatalyst.NAME: Oolacile Ivory Catalyst
OolacileIvoryCatalyst.FLAVOR: An ivory branch once used to weave old light into sorcery.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you play #yBed #yOf #yMagic, gain #b6 #yBlock and draw #b1 card.

CinderellaRosette.NAME: Cinderella Rosette
CinderellaRosette.FLAVOR: A small ornament left from a spell that ended too soon.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain #b1 #yIntelligence.

SixthSense.NAME: Sixth Sense
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain #b10 #yBlock next turn.

ToastyMittens.NAME: Toasty Mittens
ToastyMittens.FLAVOR: Warm enough to hold fresh bread without dropping the blade.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, add a #yPita #yBread to your hand.

JosephForesight.NAME: Joseph Foresight
JosephForesight.FLAVOR: An echo of Sixth Sense reaching higher ground.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain #b1 #yIntangible next turn.

HonorOfPinionfolk.NAME: Honor Of Pinionfolk
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain #b2 #yHover.

Marking.NAME: Marking
DESCRIPTIONS: Every #b2 #ySkill cards played, gain #b6 #yBlock.

FighterResolve.NAME: Fighter Resolve
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain #yUnyielding.

BorrowedLife.NAME: Borrowed Life
BorrowedLife.FLAVOR: A victory claimed before the debt is paid.
DESCRIPTIONS: #yGrey #yHealth and #yGrey #yHealth+ do not cause HP loss at the end of combat.

DebtToBond.NAME: Debt To Bond
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, if you have #yGrey #yHealth or #yGrey #yHealth+, gain [E] .

FighterDestined.NAME: Fighter Destined
FighterDestined.FLAVOR: Replaces Fighter Resolve. Victory is decided before the wound is paid.
DESCRIPTIONS: Replaces #yFighter #yResolve. At the start of each combat, gain #yUnyielding+.

OldGreataxe.NAME: Old Greataxe
OldGreataxe.FLAVOR: A dull, heavy old axe that still knows how to break poise.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you play an #yAttack that costs #b2 or more, apply #b1 #yPoise #yBreak to attacked enemies.

MagnificentPoise.NAME: Magnificent Poise
DESCRIPTIONS: Every #b3 cards played, gain #b3 #yBlock.

Suncatcher.NAME: Suncatcher
DESCRIPTIONS: Every #b2 #ySkill cards played, gain #b6 #yBlock.

SeedbedCurse.NAME: Seedbed Curse
SeedbedCurse.FLAVOR: A curse takes root in the fracture of aberration.
DESCRIPTIONS: Every time you apply #b10 #yAberration, apply #b1 #yDeathblight to a random enemy.

CrucibleCodex.NAME: Crucible Codex
CrucibleCodex.FLAVOR: After the tenth article, the words begin to burn.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, add #b1 #yCode #yX to your hand.

SummonSpirit.NAME: Summon Spirit
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your first #b3 turns, summon #ySummon: #yHelen, #ySummon: #yFrederick, and #ySummon: #ySebastian in order.

SoulForge.NAME: Soul Forge
SoulForge.FLAVOR: The ember of a spirit reforged into strength.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, if you have #ySummon , gain [E] .

YearsEntwined.NAME: Years Entwined
YearsEntwined.FLAVOR: May the years fade together, and the spirits with them.
DESCRIPTIONS: Replaces #ySummon #ySpirit. At the start of your turn, randomly #yBasic #ySummon .

Bagcraft.NAME: Bagcraft
DESCRIPTIONS: Gain #b3 Potion slots containing random potions.

Trance.NAME: Trance
DESCRIPTIONS: Every #b2 #ySkill cards played, gain #b6 #yBlock.

SacredTimber.NAME: Sacred Timber
SacredTimber.FLAVOR: A silent wooden relic, cold as stone.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain #b1 #ySpirit .

PrescientGlintEye.NAME: Prescient Glint Eye
PrescientGlintEye.FLAVOR: Before the rite, it glimpses the final glint.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain #b1 #yInsight .

WhisperingEarring.NAME: Whispering Earring
WhisperingEarring.FLAVOR: The voice beside your ear chooses the grave for you.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each turn, gain [E] . The first targeted card each turn is played randomly.
